name: TenderCells coop Plus/Pro ceiling gantry (DRAFT spec from cad/chicken-tender-coop/showcase/sc_params.py and gantry.py, PR 189 branch 091952c7)

findings.message: no jam or stall detection stated (motor current, encoder, torque limiter or shear coupling): a jammed belt, screw or ball joint is not noticed
findings.fix: add stall detection on the driver or an encoder, plus a torque limiter or shear pin where a jam can cause damage

findings.message: motorized bedding has no jam detection: shavings, eggs or a hen can stall it and overheat the motor
findings.fix: stall detection plus reverse-and-retry, and an E-STOP on the drive

findings.message: axis Z: vertical axis is held by a counterbalance (spring/counterweight), no brake. Check the residual imbalance for every tool mass (gripper vs tiller vs brush), the spring end-of-life/breakage failure mode, and add a mechanical catch or stop if the load can still fall or rise unexpectedly
mounting fastener size and count not given: rail/beam mounting capacity is unchecked
motorized deep-bedding drive needs bed mass, drive radius and drive torque
egg-bed alignment needs the pocket width and the error terms (repeatability, backlash, sag, thermal, mounting tolerance)
axis X: belts jump teeth or shred when bedding or a foreign object enters the mesh: needs a cover, a jam/stall detector and a hard stop
axis X: beam deflection 0.06 mm, within 1.10 mm
axis Y: belts jump teeth or shred when bedding or a foreign object enters the mesh: needs a cover, a jam/stall detector and a hard stop
axis Z: belts jump teeth or shred when bedding or a foreign object enters the mesh: needs a cover, a jam/stall detector and a hard stop

note: defaults are ASSUMED where stated; MISSING_INPUT findings mean the check could not run, not that the design is fine
